    About us

    Equipment for the operation theatre, since 2001.

    Meditek Equipments has been supplying hospitals and clinics since 2001. Our range covers anaesthesia machines and workstations, LED operation theatre lights, surgical tables, ICU and Fowler beds, suction apparatus, patient monitors, autoclaves, instrument wash units and bedside lockers.

    Every model is available to book, and our team will help you choose the right configuration for your theatre or ward. Call us on 9810925762 or 7982585029.

    Before you order

    1. Prices. The bold final price includes GST calculated from the supplied rates. The base price, GST rate and GST amount are shown underneath: 18% on beds, suction apparatus and autoclaves; 5% on the monitor and anaesthesia workstation. These are estimates based on the supplied text; confirm the final invoice with Meditek.
    2. Price on request. Products shown as "Price on request" are quoted after you contact us. Please call or message us.
    3. Prices can change. Prices and offers may change without notice. The price confirmed by our team at the time of your order applies.
    4. Specifications. Product images are illustrative. Specifications may be updated, so please confirm the exact configuration with our team before you pay.
    5. Payment. Payment is made by UPI. After paying, send your payment screenshot with your details on WhatsApp so we can confirm your order.
    6. Order confirmation. An order is confirmed only after we have verified your payment and contacted you.
    7. Delivery, installation and warranty. These depend on the product and are confirmed with you when you order.
    8. Contact. For any question, call 9810925762 or 7982585029.
